map.本工具用于校准（校验/维修/检测）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates (calibration/maintenance/testing) service inputs against format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; pure front-end, no upload.
map.周期管理：按设备类型、精度等级、使用年限算建议校准周期: Cycle management: compute suggested cycle by equipment type, precision grade and service life
map.超期预警：对比距上次校准月数判断是否需校准: Overdue alert: compare months since last calibration to judge if recalibration is needed
map.项目清单：按设备类型给出校准项目指南: Item list: give calibration-item guidance by equipment type
map.建议周期=基础周期(压力表6/温度仪12/万用表12/扭矩扳手6/千分尺12 月: Suggested cycle = base cycle (pressure gauge 6 / thermometer 12 / multimeter 12 / torque wrench 6 / micrometer 12 months) × precision factor (0.5/0.75/1.0/1.0); then age correction: >5 yr ×0.5, >3 yr ×0.75, else ×1.0, with a ≥1 month floor; recalibrate when months since last ≥ suggested cycle.
map.万用表、精度等级3(系数1.0)、用3年、距上次12月：基础12×1.0=12，: Multimeter, precision grade 3 (factor 1.0), used 3 yr, 12 months since last: base 12×1.0=12, age ×1.0 → 12 months, 12≥12 → recalibrate. Pressure gauge, factor 3, used 2 yr, 3 months since: 6×1.0=6, ×1.0 → 6 months, 3<6 → no calibration needed.
map.高精度设备（系数0.5）须更频繁校准（周期减半），低精度（系数1.0）可按基础周: High-precision equipment (factor 0.5) must be calibrated twice as often (half cycle); low precision (factor 1.0) follows the base cycle. The factor tracks precision grade to keep traceability reliable.
map.年限修正为什么缩短周期？: Why does age correction shorten the cycle?
map.老旧设备漂移风险升高，>3年缩短至0.75、>5年至0.5倍周期；属保守策略，关: Aging equipment drifts more — >3 yr shortens to 0.75, >5 yr to 0.5 of the cycle; a conservative policy, and critical instruments should be stricter.
map.校准周期受设备类型、精度等级和使用年限影响: Calibration cycle depends on equipment type, precision grade and service life
map.高精度设备需更频繁校准，使用年限长的设备应缩短周期: High-precision equipment needs more frequent calibration; older equipment should shorten its cycle
map.设备超出校准有效期后使用可能导致测量结果失准: Using equipment past its calibration validity may yield inaccurate measurements
map.校准（校验/维修/检测）服务工具，输入设备类型、精度等级、使用年限和上次校准间隔: This calibration tool takes equipment type, precision grade, service life and last interval, auto-computes the suggested calibration cycle and whether recalibration is needed, and outputs the matching calibration-item list. For pressure gauges, thermometers, multimeters, torque wrenches, micrometers and similar metering equipment.
map.根据精度和使用年限动态计算校准周期: Dynamically computes cycle by precision and service life
